recommendation: Develop the aligned garage/store/cinema wall route as the strongest currently identified shallow-girder alternative. A new first-floor media divider can provide the intermediate bearing without a full-height steel column. Do not present it as a verified construction design or apply it without architectural review.
methodology: Projected actual triangulated structural solids, not only their bounding rectangles, onto the horizontal plane and intersected the proposed wall rectangle. Used current native object bounds for door/furniture clearances; furniture collision screening is bounding-box only. Imported existing exact gravity solvers for an independent continuous-girder check with actual loaded-girder stations and its selfweight added once. Geometry contacts do not prove strength, stability, fire or foundation adequacy.

Move Bedroom02 coffee-table objects as well as the sofa-prefixed objects, rug, accessories, TV and media cabinet. Final native/render/navigation review remains required.

bearingDetail: Two simply supported girder ends over a215mmwall with a10mmjoint have only102.5mmnominal seats each, before fabrication/build tolerances. Do not mark that detail solved. A continuous girder across the wall avoids the central end-bearing squeeze, but introduces a negative-moment region and different support reactions. A designed cap or wider wall head is a separate alternative, not an assumed pad extension.

selfweightSensitivity.basis: Illustrative dense masonry assumption; excludes mortar/product variation, finishes,pad,restraints and loads already carried by the existing first-floor/garage/slab system. Removed steel-column weight and any duplicated partition allowance must be reconciled in the full load takeoff.

coordinationRequirements: Ground support must start on the slab atZ-0.075, not on75mmfloor finishes. The slab bears directly over the215mmcinema wall in this exact footprint; check vertical compression/local shear, reinforcement continuity and construction joints.
Continue upgraded ground masonry through the first-floor build-up to upper wall underside. Trim floor/deck/finish/ceiling layers around the wall, never seat upper masonry on a timber ledger.

M-FR-1-007 timber receiver overlaps the proposed wall south face and needs relocation with its joists/hangers. Root exact-solid check measures37.5mmnominal transverse overlap; a47.5mmsouth shift would provide10mmclearance if validated with the whole assembly.

M-FR-1-026 first-floor steel trimmer meets this wall: retain a real masonry pad pocket, include its reaction in the local wall compression/combined bearing check, and coordinate its new pad with masonry courses.

The basement cinema north wall endsX9.435. Do not widen the entire ground separator toX11.315 and call it directly stacked; the eastern remainder would add load to a spanning slab and needs separate design.

A free-ended first-floor media wall needs actual lateral restraint to structural floors/beam framing, not decorative ceilings. Design wall slenderness,eccentricity,concentrated bearing and pad compression.
A continuous steel girder has bottom-flange compression near the new internal support. Existing top-flange/deck restraint alone must not be treated as proof of lateral-torsional stability.

Recompute north-transfer reactions, variable-load patterns and support-settlement sensitivity for the selected girder continuity. All-loaded main middle reaction is about125kN, not the98.65kNsplit-piece result.
Update basement wall/raft line loads with new masonry weight, existing slab/first-floor loads and FR1-026 reaction. The load becomes distributed but total structural dead load increases.
Remove the old column only in the accepted alternative, repairing its wall/casing and floor/ceiling penetrations; retain recovery data. Preserve current first-floor and loft finish datums.
The full roof load route, main ridge, lateral system, concentrated storage/bath loads, fire/acoustic construction, temporary propping and installation remain outside this review.

LowG/main-south-only sensitivity0.9G+1.5Q gives about0.676kN upward action at the north main-to-transfer joint. Positive connection restraint is required;1.35G-only gravity patterns do not establish absence of uplift.

alternatives.assessment: It does not coincide with the garage/store and cinema bearing line. Making only this partition load-bearing does not create an onward load path. Additional ground/basement wall or transfer design would be required; it risks the basement stair arrival.

Best direct geometric route found, with limited room/furniture change and unchanged girder depth. It requires new load-bearing masonry, amended ground thickness, real support detailing and full calculations.

alternatives.route: Two girder pieces with wider/capped wall head
alternatives.assessment: Can retain the simply supported analysis basis if the actual support stations and bearing head are designed, but this adds local depth/projection and connection complexity.

sources.use: Chapter6.3: supporting walls need lateral restraint and beam/lintel bearing design. Reference guidance only; project/current regulatory basis still to be established.
